# Peptidelog / 펩타이드로그

> A free, ad-free local peptide and injection tracker with no account. Add
> compounds, turn vial mg + bacteriostatic water mL into concentration and
> syringe units (arithmetic only), log dose / time / site / notes on any day,
> keep vial inventory with a low-stock warning, run several protocol
> schedules, get a site-rotation suggestion and export a JSON backup.
> Not medical advice.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://peptidelog.try-dabble.com/
Compounds, vials, logs, schedules, supplies and preferences stay in this
browser on this device. No accounts, no sign-in, no uploads, no server
storage, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no free trial that
turns into a paywall. Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones.

This is NOT a medical service. It gives no dose recommendations, has no AI
"dosing assistant", no clinician or telehealth features, no cloud sync and no
SMS reminders. The reconstitution calculator only multiplies and divides the
numbers the person typed. Every screen carries a "not medical advice" line.

## Features

- Compounds: add, edit, delete; unlimited and free; optional unit label, default dose, notes, user-entered half-life hours
- Reconstitution calculator: vial mg + diluent mL → mg/mL and mcg/mL; desired dose → syringe units (U-100 by default, adjustable) and volume; doses per vial
- Quick dose log: compound, amount, unit, editable date & time (any day), injection site, optional vial link, notes
- Calendar: month grid, tap any past or future day, add / edit / delete logs there (not locked to today)
- Vial inventory: remaining mg or mL, low-stock threshold with a "Low" chip, automatic deduction when a log is linked to a vial
- Schedules: several named protocols, weekday or every-N-days, one or more times per day, next-7-days list, "Done" writes a log
- Site rotation: least-recently-used suggestion over common subcutaneous sites; override with one tap
- Optional half-life estimate: user-entered hours, simple halving decay, labelled "estimate only"
- Supplies checklist: swabs, syringes, water with optional quantity and low threshold
- JSON export / import of everything; delete all data
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
